title: EUMH-ATM: PR-3 Thesis Code and S14 Computational Companion
description: PR-3 S0–S13 implementation and preserved outputs, plus the separate S14 post-review computational companion. Reconstruct the original PR-3 ZIP with python packages/reassemble_package.py and the original S14 ZIP with python packages/s14/reassemble_s14.py. Both scripts verify SHA-256. S14 includes nine overlapping H=56 origin evaluations, fitted-weight holdout calibration sensitivity, cash-only scenarios, portable scripts, executed sources and saved outputs. No new untouched-confirmation or independent-origin significance claim is made. No fitted weights or secondary raw transactions are redistributed; S14 includes the supplied NN5 input files. Full training was not rerun during deposit. See the package READMEs for scope, numerical refit discrepancies and limitations.
